summary: 3D Systems Corp filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a follow-on offering of 16,393,443 shares of common stock at $3.05 per share, raising approximately $46.9 million in net proceeds. The offering price represents a ~15.5% discount to the last sale price of $3.61 on June 3, 2026. Underwriters include Needham Company and Craig-Hallum, with a 30-day option for an additional 2,459,016 shares. This is a routine capital-raising transaction and not a special situation. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No corporate action or event triggers a special-situations classification.
